code:
qc.cx(0, 1)  # control=0, target=1: flips qubit 1 only if qubit 0 is |1>
qc.cx(1, 0)  # control and target swapped -- a different circuit
caption: Conditional behavior on a qubit already in superposition is exactly what creates entanglement.

code:
qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
qc.h(0)      # superposition on qubit 0
qc.cx(0, 1)  # entangle qubit 1 with qubit 0
caption: h(0) splits qubit 0; cx(0,1) says "if qubit 0 is 1, flip qubit 1" — entangling the two into one combined state.
